name: @keetar/web
description: A browser extension that brings native KeePass vault management to Chrome and Firefox — no desktop app required.

scripts.build: pnpm run build:chrome && pnpm run build:firefox
scripts.build:chrome: pnpm run clean:chrome && webpack --config build/webpack.config.js --mode production --env browser=chrome
scripts.build:dev: pnpm run clean:chrome && webpack --config build/webpack.config.js --mode development --env browser=chrome
scripts.build:firefox: pnpm run clean:firefox && webpack --config build/webpack.config.js --mode production --env browser=firefox
scripts.build:firefox:dev: pnpm run clean:firefox && webpack --config build/webpack.config.js --mode development --env browser=firefox
scripts.lint:firefox: pnpm run build:firefox && web-ext lint --source-dir dist/firefox --no-config-discovery
